# Google.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/google-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/google-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Google.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Google Search Results](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-google) · [How to Scrape Google Maps](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-google-maps)
- **Code:** [`google.py`](google.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [SERP data](results/serp.json) · [Keyword data](results/keywords.json) · [Google Maps place URLs](results/google_map_places_urls.json) · [Google Maps place data](results/google_map_places.json) · [Ai mode](results/ai_mode.json)

## What it scrapes

- Google search pages for serp and rankings data
- Google search pages for SEO keyword data
- Google Maps for places' URLs
- Google Maps palce pages for places' data

## Functions

- `scrape_google_map_places(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape google map place pages
- `scrape_keywords(query)` → `List[str]`: request google search page for keyword data
- `scrape_serp(query, max_pages=None, resolve_goto_urls=True)` → `List[Dict]`: query google search for serp results
- `scrape_ai_mode(query, hl='en', gl='US')` → `AiModeResult`: scrape Google AI Mode (udm=50) search results

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import google


async def main():
    serp = await google.scrape_serp(
        query="scrapfly blog web scraping",
        max_pages=3,
        resolve_goto_urls=True,
    )
    keywords = await google.scrape_keywords(query="web scraping emails")
    ai_mode = await google.scrape_ai_mode(query="best web scraping tools 2026")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`AiModeSource`**: `title`, `url`, `snippet?`
- **`AiModeResult`**: `query`, `answer`, `sources`, `captured_at`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`google.py`](google.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/google-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_serp_scraping`, `test_keyword_scraping`, `test_place_url_scraping`, `test_place_scraping`, `test_ai_mode_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
